note: 001/002 measured this category directly. Starts with 1,000,000,000 Hay and 1,000,000,000 Wood -- no bootstrapping problem, Carrot costs 512 of each to plant. Growth ~7,196 ticks mean, ~17.8x hay_single's Grass (~404) -- likely growth-bound not servicing-bound, unlike hay_single. Major finding: untouched grassland has standing Grass from tick ~2 (directly confirmed, 002) -- any Grass-type companion request (1/3 of draws, since Carrot never requests itself) is satisfied for free at any position this drone hasn't overwritten, a structural advantage hay_single never had. 003 builds the reactive driver exploiting this and measures real idle time to decide whether multi-tile is worth it here (unlike Hay, where it wasn't).
